plugins.name: daily-log
plugins.description: Automatically log and summarize your daily Claude Code activity. Supports local-only and server modes.

plugins.name: superpower-validate
plugins.description: Adversarial spec/plan validation workflow (superpowers companion) — fan-out review across dimensions, 3-vote adversarial verification, PASS/FAIL verdict, web-checks external dependencies. Validates only; never authors. Generic and project-agnostic.

plugins.name: warp-cli-agent
plugins.description: Warp terminal notifications for Claude Code that also work on Windows. Tab status icons, unread badges, and "Open Conversation" notification cards. Speaks Warp's warp://cli-agent OSC 777 protocol through Claude Code's terminalSequence hook output, so it needs no bash, no jq, and no /dev/tty.
